speaker: josias_thwaite
text: Strike the stone, and not each other. This is the wall. The book stays open.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: That is the third mark, Master Gillis. The stone in the garden wall. You have had the post in Bishopsgate Street, and the corner by Crosby Place, and now this.

speaker: gillis_verbeke
text: The post. The corner. The stone. If a warden asks, I will point at these, and I will not add a fourth.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Do not add one. Three is the parish. She showed you each.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Hold the wand off my apron. The boys can reach a person without meaning it.

speaker: josias_thwaite
text: A psalm-verse at the post, a psalm-verse at the corner, and a psalm-verse here. At each, a prayer for the fruits of the earth.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: The words were the old words. They sounded thinner. The prayer asked for the fruits, and the mouths were on the wheat.

speaker: josias_thwaite
text: I should like the fruits to have been listening. We have been out forty minutes. The parish is walked. There is bread, and there is ale.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Sit, then. The loaf is this morning's loaf. A finger and a half short of the notch, and a penny, and the walk has not mended it.

speaker: (a neighbour)
text: With wheat where it is, the Mayor might better look to the meal-tubs than the laundry-tubs.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: And there is a precept coming from Crosby Place against blue starch. I have not got the paper. I will not obey a sentence I have not heard.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: I have one band that was starched blue. I bought it at Whitsun last. If the colour is to be forbid, I will ask you, mistress, and not the street.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: You will ask me when the paper is in the house. It is not in the house today.

speaker: josias_thwaite
text: When it is sent to be read, it will be read. Today the book was the psalms and the fruits. I will not preach a paper I have not got.

speaker: gillis_verbeke
text: I was shown each mark, as if I might be asked. I can be asked. I know the three. I do not know the Mayor's laundry.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Keep the three names. The precept is talk with a good address. Crosby Place can send the paper when the paper is ready.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I will write the names as they are called. Post, corner, stone. I will not improve them.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: He said them back to me. The post, the corner, the stone. I heard him twice.

speaker: gillis_verbeke
text: Twice is enough to be honest. A third time would be a lesson, and the lesson was the pointing.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Drink. You have been a parishioner for forty minutes. You may be a poet when the cup is done.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Then I am a parishioner until the cup is done. The king is off his wall at home, and there is no glass in that scene.

speaker: josias_thwaite
text: Take him home when you have drunk. Three marks, three prayers, and the ale while it is honest.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: The boys may leave the wands at the porch. I am not paying for a fourth mark.

speaker: gillis_verbeke
text: I have three marks. I will not count the boys into the parish.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: The notch on the loaf is yours, mistress. I have nothing to add to the measure.

speaker: josias_thwaite
text: I will not put the loaf into the prayer. The prayer has its own measure, and it is not a notch.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: I will bring the wands home if they are still whole. I counted four this morning.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Home. A finger and a half, and a parish that still ends where it ended.
